name: azul_widgets_a_click_on_a_phone_button_is_seen_in_the_display_features_and_in_two_pictures
description: What a click on the Pixel 8 button does, step by step, with the answers kept: where the button is, a picture before, the click, three frames, what the window says (display features), a picture after, half a second more. It passes on a desktop; on a phone it is the diagnosis of a click that changes nothing (Android emulator 2026-11-28: after the click the display features still said "off"): every step runs whatever the one before said, the first failing step is the one to read, and the two pictures (AZ_E2E_SHOT_DIR) show the page before and after.

steps.text: A phone to try it on
